patterns.rationale: Matches `get_env` with zero or more deprecated format chars (U+206A–U+206F) or Musical Symbol Begin/End Beam chars (U+1D173–U+1D17A) between every character. The character class is composed entirely of invisible non-printing Unicode format/notation chars that have no legitimate presence in prose, YAML values, or JSON strings. The surrounding letters still spell out the exact tool name, keeping the pattern narrow.
patterns.fp_notes: None. U+206A–U+206F are deprecated Unicode format chars removed from Unicode 6.3 "use" recommendations; U+1D173–U+1D17A are music-notation-only invisible beam markers. Neither range appears in any of the known-good corpus files. The only plausible FP would be a music notation document that happened to embed these chars adjacent to the letters g-e-t-_-e-n-v, which is not a realistic benign scenario.

patterns.rationale: Same technique as Pattern 1, applied to `send_http`. Anchors on the full 9-character sequence s-e-n-d-_-h-t-t-p with the same two invisible-char ranges optionally interspersed. Catches the `send_http` obfuscation in Miss 2 and Miss 5; Miss 9's payload is truncated before `send_http` appears but the same obfuscation technique would apply if completed.
patterns.fp_notes: The string "send" with invisible chars between letters followed by "_http" has no plausible benign occurrence. The known-good corpus contains no `send_http` references whatsoever.
